Concord, California ✦ City Council · District 3 ✦ November 2026
Elect
# Don Seta For Concord City Council · District 3
✦
Serve the Community. Safety Today. Green Future.
Common-sense leadership for a stronger Concord.
Donate Join the Campaign Read the Platform Contact Don Follow on Instagram Follow on Facebook
✦
A Word from Don Seta
I come from a family of immigrants, who started with nothing. Just when they started to prosper, they were interned during WWII and had to start all over again. For them, hard work and a community that looked out for one another weren’t ideals — they were a way of life. I deeply understand the responsibility of community leaders to care for every resident in the community, with priority to those who need it the most.
✦
Credentials and Civic Leadership Roles
- Lt. Colonel, United States Air Force (Ret.)
- Doctorate in Business Administration, Alliant International University, San Diego
- Master of Science in Systems Management, University of Southern California, Los Angeles
- Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, University of California, Berkeley
- Director, Concord Ambassadors
- Director, Concord Historical Society
- Director, Concord Diablo Rotary Club
- Vice Chairman, Measure X Community Advisory Board
- Commissioner, American Legion Aerospace Commission of California
Platform Priorities
01
📋
### Serve the Community
“The test of our progress is… whether we provide enough for those who have too little.” — Harry Truman
I believe in responsible, fiscally disciplined city spending and in keeping District 3 fully informed about how and why decisions are made. I am equally committed to protecting our community and fostering an environment where opportunity is available to everyone. I intend to represent the needs of the constituents of District 3 and contribute to Concord's future.
02
🛡️
### Safety Today
The first duty of local government is to ensure the safety of its residents. District 3 families deserve timely emergency response and neighborhoods where people feel secure. I support Concord police, fire, and emergency services. These professionals put themselves at risk for our protection and deserve our support. Crisis preparedness can always improve, and I’m ready to champion that work. We can also strengthen pedestrian safety along our busiest streets — especially the Monument corridor — so people feel comfortable and confident moving through their own community.
03
🌳
### Green Future
Our parks are the living rooms of our neighborhoods — where children play, seniors walk, and families gather. Starting with Lake Ellis, regular maintenance is a must. I will fight to protect green space and upgrade park amenities in District 3. We also owe it to our children to leave the planet better than we found it.
Green also signifies prosperity, starting with education. My Mexican Japanese American grandchildren have taught me an important lesson — Concord's strength lies in its brilliant, ambitious, multicultural youth. If District 3 schools are struggling, it's not the kids.
Core Values
- Public Safety ✦
- Honest Government ✦
- Neighborhood Preservation ✦
- Community First
✦
Get Involved
District 3 wins when neighbors show up for each other. Tell us how you'd like to help, and we'll follow up.
## District 3 Deserves
Principled Leadership.
I was born in Concord, and I grew up watching my parents work to strengthen our community. I want to carry that tradition forward and help build a city government committed to safe neighborhoods & streets, and vibrant parks. And we need to balance the budget.
